asin_rule.claim: An ASIN is a 10-character alphanumeric identifier, so a 9-character code cannot be an ASIN.

policy_statements.claim: Operating Agreement §5 required disclosure wording.
policy_statements.quote: You must clearly and prominently state the following, or any substantially similar statement previously allowed under this Agreement, on your Site … “As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.”

policy_statements.claim: Operating Agreement §6: a Section 5 violation is a material breach.
policy_statements.quote: For the avoidance of doubt and without limitation for purposes of the foregoing subsection (a) any violation of Section 5 and as specified in the Program Policies will be deemed a material breach of this Agreement.

policy_statements.claim: Participation Requirements 2(b): every Special Link must carry the Associates tag.
policy_statements.quote: you must include your Associates ID or “tag” (appearing as XXXXX-##, or such other format as we may designate) as a parameter in the URL of each link you place on your Site to an Amazon Site.

policy_statements.claim: Participation Requirements 2(b): prices and availability only via an Amazon-served link or the API.
policy_statements.quote: your Site may only show prices and availability if: (a) we serve the link in which that price and availability data are displayed, or (b) you obtain Product pricing and availability data via Creators API or PA API and you comply with the requirements regarding use of Creators API or PA API in the License.

policy_statements.claim: Participation Requirements 6(t): customer reviews and star ratings only via Creators API / PA API.
policy_statements.quote: You will not display or otherwise use any of our customer reviews or star ratings, in part or in whole, on your Site unless you have obtained a link to that customer review or star rating through Creators API or PA API and you comply with the requirements for Creators API and PA API described in the License.

policy_statements.claim: Participation Requirements 6(w): link shorteners must not obscure the Amazon destination.
policy_statements.quote: You will not use a link shortening service, button, hyperlink or other ad placement in a manner that makes it unclear that you are linking to an Amazon Site.

policy_statements.claim: Commission Income Statement 2(e): Redirecting Links disqualify purchases.
policy_statements.quote: any Product purchased by a customer who is referred to an Amazon Site by a link that sends users indirectly to an Amazon Site via an intermediate site, without requiring the customer to click on a link or take some other affirmative action on that intermediate site (a “Redirecting Link”)

policy_statements.claim: Participation Requirements 6(v): no cloaking or obscured URLs.
policy_statements.quote: You will not cloak, hide, spoof, or otherwise obscure the URL of your Site containing Special Links (including by use of Redirecting Links) …

policy_statements.claim: Participation Requirements 2(b): no inaccurate or misleading product claims.
